title: My first game attempt with 9-5 job. First demo Devlog#1
author: TheZerachiel
selftext:
I work a 8-5 job. For years I've played lots of game and i wanted to make my own game, so I finally with help of ai  i decided to spend my evenings on it. This is the very first demo: ancient heroes vs a Minotaur. For testing the skill of my ai skills. Rough, early, and everything will change. Devlog #1  I hope it will be live for you to play and give me feedbacks.  
By the way. I am backend developer at origin. And this is ofc ai assist. I cant even make their helmet on my own 😄   
Feel free to ive feedback. I am looking for posting next devlog too
